round_note: Holiday shopping is underway: picks from Amazon's 2026 Toys We Love list, plus the gift-ready tech and winter skincare that keep selling.

picks.name: Fire TV Stick HD
picks.why: The cheapest way to make an older TV smart, and one of Amazon's most-gifted devices every holiday season.

picks.name: Anker Nano Power Bank
picks.why: Pocket-size charger with a built-in connector, so there's no cable to forget. A favorite stocking stuffer.
picks.query: Anker Nano Power Bank built-in connector

picks.name: Amazon Smart Plug (2-Pack)
picks.why: Puts holiday lights and lamps on a schedule or Alexa voice control. One of the most-reviewed smart home items on Amazon.

picks.name: Apple AirTag (2nd Generation)
picks.why: Track keys, wallets and luggage from your iPhone. A top stocking stuffer, and it's discounted ahead of holiday travel.

picks.name: COSRX Acne Pimple Patches (240 Count)
picks.why: Hydrocolloid patches that flatten breakouts overnight. A big multi-pack featured in Amazon's Holiday Beauty Event.
picks.query: COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch 240 count

picks.name: Medicube Toner Pads
picks.why: K-beauty toner pads that were among the best-selling skincare of October. A quick, no-mess way to prep skin.

picks.name: LANEIGE Lip Glowy Balm
picks.why: Tinted, glossy lip balm that moisturizes without feeling sticky. A beauty best seller and an easy small gift.

picks.name: CeraVe Skin Renewing Night Cream
picks.why: Ceramide night cream that locks in moisture while you sleep. A dermatologist-favorite brand that's on sale this week.

picks.name: Mueller 12-Cup Drip Coffee Maker
picks.why: Simple programmable drip coffee maker at a deep discount this week. Easy upgrade before holiday guests arrive.

picks.name: KitchenAid Silicone Oven Mitts (2-Pack)
picks.why: Ribbed silicone mitts with a soft lining, ready for holiday baking. A top kitchen seller this fall.
picks.query: KitchenAid Ribbed Soft Silicone Oven Mitt 2 pack

picks.name: Tony's Chocolonely Chocolate Bar Pack
picks.why: A six-bar Fairtrade gift set in assorted flavors. Picked for Amazon's stocking stuffers under $25.
picks.query: Tony's Chocolonely chocolate bar variety pack 6

picks.name: EverFoams Fuzzy Slippers
picks.why: Faux-fur slippers with memory foam and a non-slip sole. Cold-weather favorites that sell out by December.
picks.query: EverFoams women's fuzzy memory foam slippers

picks.name: Owala FreeSip 40 oz Water Bottle
picks.why: Insulated bottle you can sip through the straw or swig from the spout. One of the most-bought water bottles on Amazon.
picks.query: Owala FreeSip 40 oz stainless steel water bottle

picks.name: Bocce's Bakery Dog Advent Calendar
picks.why: Twelve days of all-natural dog treats. A fun way to include the dog in the holiday countdown.
picks.query: Bocce's Bakery 12 day advent calendar for dogs

picks.name: Kanoodle 20th Anniversary Fan Edition
picks.why: A pocket-size logic puzzle with hundreds of challenges. Named to Amazon's 2026 Toys We Love list.
picks.query: Educational Insights Kanoodle Fan Edition 20th Anniversary

picks.name: CATAN On The Road Card Game
picks.why: A travel-friendly card version of the classic strategy game, and one of the most affordable picks on Amazon's 2026 Toys We Love list.
